nodes.label: Fish Audio Integration
nodes.rationale: Japanese text-to-speech with multiple voices, speech-to-text for pronunciation checking, clip caching

nodes.label: Learning Features
nodes.rationale: Selection lookup with Ctrl+Alt+J, spaced repetition reviews, speech recognition via Fish Audio, smart reminders

nodes.label: Tutor System
nodes.rationale: Two silent tools (log_progress, assess_level) track learner progression in learner.json and adapt teaching level

nodes.label: Linux Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds Linux app (AppImage, .deb, .rpm) from same Tauri project as Windows with layer-shell support

nodes.label: Windows Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow for Windows app building and publishing NSIS installer and portable binaries

nodes.label: Version Consistency Check
nodes.rationale: Three files carry the version (tauri.conf.json, package.json, Cargo.toml) and must agree

nodes.label: Good First Contributions
nodes.rationale: Service integrations, new agents, new emotes/sounds, and bug fixes are good starting points

nodes.label: Release Build Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: macOS release workflow that verifies build compilation on clean machine, notarization done locally

nodes.label: Pill Catalog
nodes.rationale: Central registry in PillCatalog.swift defining all available agent pills, colors, and categories

nodes.label: Mochi
nodes.rationale: Animated character drawn in code, lives in the notch, communicates task states and events through emotions and movements

nodes.label: Notch Buddy
nodes.rationale: macOS app with Mochi character in the notch, integrates with AI coding agents and services

nodes.label: Kotoba
nodes.rationale: Japanese learning app built from Coucou's Tauri shell on Windows and Linux, teaches with Mochi as AI tutor

nodes.label: Notch Buddy Prototype
nodes.rationale: Visual prototype and interactive reference for the notch buddy UI, source of truth for design dimensions

nodes.label: Third-Party Agent Integration
nodes.rationale: Allows external tools to create pills in the island and send events via Unix domain socket or named pipe

nodes.label: Claude API for Search
nodes.rationale: Sends window captures, URLs, and text prompts to Claude for context-aware search and analysis

nodes.label: Claude Code Integration
nodes.rationale: Hook-based integration that routes Claude Code events to Coucou via socket, enables approval and question answering from notch

nodes.label: File Handling and Upload
nodes.rationale: Drag-drop files into notch, upload to inbox folder, prompt Claude API with file context or send via mail

nodes.label: Mail Integration
nodes.rationale: Send files via AppleScript to Mail.app with addressee, subject, and attachment

nodes.label: n8n Workflow Integration
nodes.rationale: Polling-based integration that monitors n8n workflows and displays execution status and errors in island

nodes.label: Multi-Provider Chat
nodes.rationale: Support for Claude, Google AI, and OpenAI with per-provider model selection and streaming

nodes.label: Window Attachment with Halo
nodes.rationale: Drag Mochi onto a window to attach it, displaying animated halo and capturing window context

nodes.label: Skin Bundle Format
nodes.rationale: ZIP format containing manifest.json and PNG layers for Mochi hairstyles, with bend and pivot behaviors

nodes.label: Skin Editor
nodes.rationale: Built into Settings, allows creating and editing skins by dropping images and configuring layer properties visually

nodes.label: Manifest.json Structure
nodes.rationale: Defines skin metadata, layers with roles (back/front/top), fit parameters, behaviors (bend/pivot), and optional springs for physics

nodes.label: Animation System
nodes.rationale: Spring-based easing for island expansion (520ms), content transitions with blur and scale, sequential mini-bonhomme animations

nodes.label: Eye Tracking and Camera
nodes.rationale: Eyes follow mouse with perspective projection and random blinks; no permissions needed

nodes.label: Color System
nodes.rationale: State colors, wash gradients, eye colors, and agent pill colors with specific hex values and opacity rules

nodes.label: Character Emotes
nodes.rationale: 7 short reactions (love, surprised, proud, wink, yawn, content, annoyed) that overlay current state and are triggered by user actions

nodes.label: Geometry and Layout
nodes.rationale: Island modes scale from notch width to 640pt; character scales and repositions; layout constants derived from prototype

nodes.label: Island
nodes.rationale: Summoned surface interface that shows tasks and interactions, expands from notch area to full panel with modes: hidden, peek, compact, expanded

nodes.label: Mochi Rendering Engine
nodes.rationale: Pure code rendering using Canvas with TimelineView, superellipse body, eye projection on sphere, contextual coloring and glow

nodes.label: Mouse Interactions
nodes.rationale: Hover effects, single/triple click behaviors, drag-to-attach Mochi to windows, drag files to upload with morphing feedback

nodes.label: Pill System
nodes.rationale: Colored mini-agents showing active sessions; declared pills (in catalog + checked in Settings) persist after session ends; max 4 active at once

nodes.label: Sound Events
nodes.rationale: Distinct sounds for peek, open, close, hover, slap, approval, error, finish, upload progression

nodes.label: Audio System
nodes.rationale: 28 WAV sounds (48kHz stereo) triggered by state changes, interactions, and events; volume normalization and user control

nodes.label: Character States
nodes.rationale: 11 emotional states (idle, working, thinking, searching, approval, question, error, finished, ratelimit, sleeping, dizzy) with unique eye expressions, colors, and badges

nodes.label: Task Ticker
nodes.rationale: Scrolling view of recent session actions/n8n nodes with shimmer effect on current line, rolls every 2.8s

nodes.label: Island Views
nodes.rationale: 15 expanded UI views (overview, empty, approval, question, error, finished, upload, prompt, searching, result, note, etc.) each with specific layout and interaction model

nodes.label: Study Panel
nodes.rationale: Large island view for Kotoba learning: Talk, Progress, and word review with AI tutor responses

nodes.label: Gemini Provider Support
nodes.rationale: Chat support for Google AI (Gemini) and ability to switch between providers

nodes.label: Hook System for Agents
nodes.rationale: Any agent can talk to Mochi by tagging hook payload with coucou_agent, gets own pill in island

nodes.label: Keyboard Shortcut Customization
nodes.rationale: Every key the app listens to is listed in Settings and can be rebound

nodes.label: OpenAI Provider Support
nodes.rationale: Chat support for OpenAI models in addition to Anthropic

nodes.label: Kotoba
nodes.rationale: Japanese-learning app on kotoba branch, built from Coucou's Tauri shell for Windows

nodes.label: Branding and Asset Rights
nodes.rationale: Coucou and Mochi names, character design, app icons, sounds owned by Louis Raillé, not covered by MIT license

nodes.label: Coucou MOD
nodes.rationale: Windows fork of Coucou, treats Windows as primary target with summoned island UI instead of docked overlay

nodes.label: Mochi
nodes.rationale: Small animated character that lives in the MacBook notch (macOS) or as a summoned island (Windows)

nodes.label: Skin Editor
nodes.rationale: Built-in editor to create character skins from user pictures with live preview

nodes.label: Greeting Animation Sequence
nodes.rationale: Canvas-based animation prototype showing Mochi greeting entrance sequence with island expansion

nodes.label: File Upload Sequence Animation
nodes.rationale: Canvas-based animation prototype showing file drop sequence with Mochi eating the file

nodes.label: UI Design Rules
nodes.rationale: No white or light borders on UI surfaces, concentric corners, Inter font for Windows/Linux, Phosphor Fill icons, separate things with fill and tone

nodes.label: Chat Assistant Features
nodes.rationale: Claude or Gemini with tools for files, apps, media and PowerShell, each risky action gated by approval card

nodes.label: Home Screen UI
nodes.rationale: Shows current tool, file being touched with readable diff, Git status, usage metrics

nodes.label: NotchBuddy
nodes.rationale: Native macOS app implementation in NotchBuddy/ directory with Swift code

nodes.label: macOS Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow that tests macOS app compilation with XcodeGen and Swift checks

nodes.label: Bundle Identifiers
nodes.rationale: fr.louisraille.NotchBuddy (main), fr.louisraille.Coucou (App Store), fr.louisraille.kotoba (Kotoba app)

nodes.label: Keychain for Secrets
nodes.rationale: All secrets stored in Keychain, never on disk or in git

nodes.label: Performance Zero CPU Rule
nodes.rationale: App must use 0% CPU when the island is hidden

nodes.label: Swift Development Rules
nodes.rationale: Swift 6, SwiftUI + AppKit required, no third-party dependencies unless truly unavoidable, character drawn in code with Canvas and TimelineView

nodes.label: XcodeGen
nodes.rationale: Project generation tool used to create Xcode project from YAML configuration, never edit .xcodeproj by hand
